bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Unclean shutdown detected for Google Chrome. The disk cache index did not close properly (checksum mismatch), leaving orphaned entries that can slow page loads and disrupt media playback. A safe cache rebuild will reconcile metadata and remove stale blocks without affecting bookmarks, history, or passwords.
